disclaimers.dataFreshness: Programme details come from university brochures for the 2024-2025 intakes. Fees, scholarships and deadlines change every year - confirm the latest details with IFFI Consultant before applying.
disclaimers.universityNames: University names are shared during your free consultation.
disclaimers.costEstimate: Estimates only. Living costs are typical student budgets by city tier; exchange rates update daily. Ask us for an exact quote.
disclaimers.eligibility: Indicative only - this is not an admission or scholarship decision. Final decisions are made by universities and scholarship bodies.
disclaimers.mbbsRecognition: Recognition by your home medical council (e.g. PM&DC in Pakistan) depends on the university and year - we verify it for each student before applying.
